newsitem.title: USA: UniComp management, units to buy shares.
newsitem.headline: UniComp management, units to buy shares.

text.p: UniComp Inc said on Thursday that its management and affiliates will buy up to 200,000 shares of the company's common stock over the next year on the open market.
The company did not say which officers or affiliates would buy shares.

Stephen Hafer, the company's president and chief executive, said in a statement, "We anticipate continued growth from our subsidiaries and as a result, we consider this investment a sound financial asset."
Officials from the company were not immediately available to comment further.
The company now has about 7.1 million shares of common stock outstanding, a company spokesman said.
The 200,000 shares would comprise about 3 percent of the 7.1 million, he said.
